<roll> is a good key (grain, timber, fish, ...) and <ordinal> is the hex
number (1..18) from `keryx city`. Rejected if the hex has no such production
option, is already full for that good, or hasn't been
scouted yet.

Omit the delta to place a single citizen (default +1, unchanged from before).
+n places n more; -n returns n citizens from that hex to the idle pool — free
and immediate. To move a citizen from a hex into a building:

  keryx place grain 5 -1
  keryx staff olive_press +1

Usage:
  keryx place [city] <good> <ordinal> [+n|-n] [flags]

Examples:
  keryx place grain 5
  keryx place --province <prov-id> livestock 5
  keryx place grain 5 +2
  keryx place grain 5 -1

Flags:
  -h, --help              help for place
      --hex string        catchment coordinate q,r or ordinal 6/#6; put flags before the good
      --province string   province ID/name to place in (default: your capital)

Global Flags:
  -j, --json   output as JSON (for scripts and MCP)
